restore_old_photo.prompt: Full professional restoration of this vintage photograph. Remove all damage including tears, fading, scratches, and discoloration,keep same color tone as original photo

restore_old_photo_colorize.prompt: Full professional restoration of this vintage photograph. Remove all damage including tears, fading, scratches, and discoloration and colorize the photo.Use natural skin tones and historically accurate colors. Avoid artificial saturation.

colorize_photo.prompt: Colorize this black and white image realistically.Use natural skin tones and historically accurate colors. Avoid artificial saturation.

enhance_photo.prompt: Enhance image quality while preserving details.

professional_headshot.prompt: Turn this photo into a professional headshot. Dress the person in formal business attire, use a clean neutral studio background and soft, even studio lighting. Keep the person's face, identity and hairstyle unchanged.

sharpen_denoise.prompt: Remove noise and blur from this photo and make it sharp and clear. Keep the colors, composition and all details unchanged.

white_background.prompt: Replace the background with a clean white studio backdrop. Keep the subject, its edges and its proportions unchanged.

remove_background_people.prompt: Remove the people in the background. Fill the areas so they match the surrounding scene. Keep the main subject and everything else unchanged.

product_photo.prompt: Turn this into a professional product photo. Place the product on a clean surface with soft studio lighting and a natural shadow. Keep the product, its shape and its label unchanged.

golden_hour.prompt: Change the time of day to golden hour, with warm low sunlight and long soft shadows. Keep the composition and all objects unchanged.

cartoon_to_photo.prompt: Convert this cartoon into a realistic photograph. Use natural textures, realistic proportions and soft natural lighting. Keep the same clothing colors, background and composition.

photo_to_cartoon.prompt: Convert this photo into a colorful cartoon illustration with clean outlines and flat shading. Keep the subject recognizable and the composition unchanged.

photo_to_modern_3d_cartoon.prompt: Convert this photo into a modern 3D animated film style. Use smooth stylized shapes, expressive features, soft cinematic lighting and rich, vibrant colors. Keep the subject recognizable, with the same pose, clothing and composition.

photo_to_modern_2d_cartoon.prompt: Convert this photo into a modern 2D cartoon illustration, like a contemporary animated series. Use bold clean outlines, simple cel shading and a bright, vibrant color palette. Keep the subject recognizable, with the same pose, clothing and composition.

pencil_sketch.prompt: Convert this photo into a clean pencil sketch with fine shading on white paper. Keep the composition unchanged.

crayon_style.prompt: Please turn the whole image into a crayon-style drawing. Simplify the details so it looks like something a 10-year-old would draw. Don’t use the original colors from the photo. Make it look like it’s drawn on white paper, with a very cute and playful feel. You can add adorable elements like flowers, candy, stars, clouds, etc., to make it look more childlike and innocent.

impressionist_painting.prompt: Turn this photo into an impressionist painting with visible brush strokes. Keep the composition and main subject recognizable.

acrylic_painting.prompt: Transform image into a flattened, vibrant acrylic painting. Strip object to solid color with simplified forms. No shading, no shadows, no gradients. Add hand-painted texture with imperfect outlines and wobbly edges. Minimal details.

coloring_page.prompt: A black and white line drawing coloring illustration.The overall illustration style is fresh and simple, using clear and smooth black outline lines, without shadows, grayscale, or color filling, with a pure white background for easy coloring.
